sections.description: Lower-level section beside the stage on the right. It puts you close to the performers while keeping a clear look across the room.
Sweet-spot lower right-center. You are closer to the stage without giving up the broad view Mystère needs for its aerial work.
Sweet-spot lower center. This is the straight-on choice if you want to be closer while still seeing the full stage picture.
Sweet-spot lower left-center. You get the same strong lower-level balance of closeness and a broad production view.
Lower-level section beside the stage on the left. It puts you close to the performers while keeping a clear look across the room.
Outer 200-level section on the right. A wider side perspective that keeps the stage and overhead work in view.
Sweet-spot upper right-center. The 200 level gives you a broad look at the full stage and the aerial space above it.
Sweet-spot upper center. This is the most straight-on full-production view in the 200 level.
Sweet-spot upper left-center. The 200 level gives you a broad look at the full stage and the aerial space above it.
Sweet-spot upper-left section. It gives you a wide look across the room and a strong full-production perspective.
Outer 200-level section on the left. A wider side perspective that keeps the stage and overhead work in view.
